raw_need: Release QIF v0.6.51 Recovery Observation Windows and Delayed Side-Effect Reconciliation
validated_need: Recovery closure must remain auditable across a bounded observation period so late effects, state changes, and unresolved inconsistencies are not erased by a point-in-time retry record
decision_summary: Visionary sees a new long-horizon quality boundary, Builder can add it locally to calibration-report, and Guardian identifies premature closure and hidden delayed effects as concrete loss boundaries. The need is distinct from v0.6.50 point-in-time recovery state and remains evidence-focused.

validation_questions_answered.question: What is in scope?
validation_questions_answered.answer: calibration-report schema, verifier, example, fixtures, docs, portable package, and release; no external integration or operational action

validation_questions_answered.question: How is success judged?
validation_questions_answered.answer: reproducible observation-window arithmetic, effect-state transitions, reconciliation, governance routing, full tests, portable verification, AOF verification, and release

hidden_assumptions: a stop request means in-flight work and effects have stopped
one clean observation is enough to close recovery
an absent effect at retry time will never appear later
evidence_gaps: the committed package remains example-only and cannot prove vendor behavior, external state truth, or a universally sufficient observation duration
